scope: Bounded official-source Canadian foundation. Provincial and territorial pathways are preferred over shallow location duplication.

notes: Existing NIHB medical transportation, Hope for Wellness and First Nations/Inuit treatment-directory records were not duplicated.
211 bulk data was deferred pending permission or a data-sharing agreement.
The time-limited Nunavut Client Travel policy was deferred; current community access and medical-travel sources were used instead.

records.name: Manitoba Mental Health & Addictions Connect
records.description: Provincial intake and referral pathway connecting individuals, caregivers and service providers with community mental-health, substance-use and problem-gambling services.
records.population_served: People seeking the listed practical service
records.access_pathway: Call the toll-free provincial access point. Individuals, caregivers and providers may initiate a referral; consent is required when a provider refers.

records.name: Rapid Access to Addictions Medicine Clinic - Brandon
records.description: Walk-in rapid-access addiction medicine clinic offering assessment, counselling, addiction medications including opioid agonist treatment, and connection to ongoing care.
records.population_served: People seeking the listed practical service
records.service_area: Brandon and Prairie Mountain Health region
records.access_pathway: Review current registration times on the official RAAM page or call the clinic; no formal referral is required for the walk-in clinic.

source.title: Rapid Access to Addictions Medicine Clinic - Brandon

records.name: Rapid Access to Addictions Medicine Clinic - Thompson
records.description: Northern Manitoba rapid-access addiction medicine clinic offering assessment, counselling, addiction medications including opioid agonist treatment, and connection to ongoing care.
records.population_served: People seeking the listed practical service
records.access_pathway: Review current registration times on the official RAAM page or call Eaglewood Treatment Centre before travelling.

source.title: Rapid Access to Addictions Medicine Clinic - Thompson

records.name: Northern Patient Transportation Program
records.description: Subsidizes eligible medical transportation for northern Manitoba residents who must travel for medical or hospital care unavailable in their home community.
records.population_served: People seeking the listed practical service
records.access_pathway: A physician must approve the travel and current program eligibility must be confirmed with the appropriate northern office before arrangements are made.
records.eligibility: Manitoba residents in the geographic areas listed by Manitoba Health who need eligible care unavailable in their home community; other coverage can affect eligibility.

eligible_trip_types: Eligible medical or hospital care unavailable in the home community
transportation.delivery: Physician approval and regional-office coordination required

records.name: ConnexOntario Addiction and Mental Health Navigation
records.description: Free, confidential 24/7 phone, text, chat and email navigation for Ontario addiction, mental-health and problem-gambling treatment and support services.
records.population_served: People seeking the listed practical service
records.access_pathway: Call 1-866-531-2600, text CONNEX to 247247, or use web chat. A name is not required; location may be shared optionally to find nearby services.

source.title: ConnexOntario Addiction and Mental Health Navigation

records.name: Northern Health Travel Grant Program
records.description: Financial assistance for eligible Northern Ontario residents travelling long distances to the nearest medical specialist or ministry-funded healthcare facility for services unavailable locally.
records.population_served: People seeking the listed practical service
records.access_pathway: Review eligibility and submit the official online or paper application within the stated deadline. Each round trip requires a separate application.
records.eligibility: Ontario's current distance, residency, insured-service and application requirements apply; the official page states a 100 km one-way minimum for the nearest eligible service.

eligible_trip_types: Eligible specialist or ministry-funded healthcare services unavailable locally
travel_modes: Eligible personal, public, rail or air travel under current program rules

records.name: Ontario Indigenous Mental Health and Addiction Treatment and Healing Centres
records.description: Official Ontario pathway listing Indigenous mental-health and addiction treatment and healing centres, including residential and non-residential programs and northern crisis-team supports.
records.population_served: First Nations, Métis and Inuit people seeking culturally grounded mental-health or addiction services; individual provider rules apply.
records.access_pathway: Use the official list to contact the identified provider directly and confirm its current intake, eligibility and location before travel.

source.title: Ontario Indigenous Mental Health and Addiction Treatment and Healing Centres

records.name: Drogue : aide et référence
records.organization: Centre de référence du Grand Montréal
records.description: Service bilingue, gratuit, confidentiel et anonyme d'information, d'écoute et de référence concernant l'alcool, les drogues et les médicaments.
records.population_served: People seeking the listed practical service
records.access_pathway: Appelez le 1 800 265-2626 partout au Québec ou le 514 527-2626 à Montréal; le clavardage est aussi offert aux résidents du Québec.

source.title: Drogue : aide et référence
source.authority: Centre de référence du Grand Montréal

records.name: Info-Social 811
records.description: Service gratuit et confidentiel de consultation téléphonique psychosociale et d'orientation vers les ressources appropriées.
records.population_served: People seeking the listed practical service
records.service_area: Régions du Québec sauf les Terres-Cries-de-la-Baie-James et le Nunavik
records.scope_note: Province-wide in most Quebec regions, but not offered in the Terres-Cries-de-la-Baie-James or Nunavik.
records.access_pathway: Composez le 811, option 2, depuis le Québec. Le service est offert 24 heures sur 24; les exclusions territoriales officielles demeurent applicables.

records.name: Isuarsivik Regional Recovery Centre
records.description: Inuit-governed Nunavik recovery centre offering an eight-week in-house program in Kuujjuaq plus in-person or remote community, pre-care, after-care, cultural and detention supports.
records.population_served: James Bay and Northern Quebec Agreement beneficiaries age 18 or older; current program requirements apply.
records.service_area: Nunavik and eligible JBNQA beneficiaries living elsewhere
records.access_pathway: Complete the applicable adult and medical forms and submit them to intake@isuarsivik.ca, or call a liaison worker for help with the process.
records.eligibility: JBNQA beneficiaries age 18 or older. The official application page also describes access for eligible beneficiaries living in Montréal, Québec or Ottawa.

records.name: New Brunswick Addiction Services
records.description: Provincial pathway to Horizon and Vitalité addiction services, including withdrawal management, outpatient counselling, addiction medicine and live-in treatment.
records.population_served: People seeking the listed practical service
records.access_pathway: Call the free 24/7 provincial addiction and mental-health helpline or the regional centre listed on the official page to confirm current access.

records.name: Addiction Services - Moncton Withdrawal Management
records.organization: Government of New Brunswick / Horizon Health Network
records.description: Moncton Addiction Services location listed by New Brunswick for withdrawal management and connection to other addiction services.
records.population_served: People seeking the listed practical service
records.access_pathway: Call the Moncton centre to confirm current withdrawal-management intake before travelling.

records.population_served: People seeking the listed practical service

source.title: Mental Health and Addictions Provincial Intake Service

records.scope_note: One provincial program with multiple physical locations; consult the official location list rather than assuming a centre is in every community.
records.access_pathway: Call a listed centre directly, call provincial intake, or use walk-in access where the official location listing permits it.

physical_location.address: 2814 Route 215, Mount Herbert, Charlottetown, PE C1A 7N8

records.name: Yukon Mental Wellness and Substance Use Services
records.description: Territorial access to free counselling, safe withdrawal support, intensive treatment and family support, including connection to community counsellors outside Whitehorse.
records.population_served: People seeking the listed practical service
records.access_pathway: Call the territorial line for a counsellor or intake information. People in communities can use the same toll-free number to locate their community counsellor.

source.title: Yukon Mental Wellness and Substance Use Services

records.description: Live-in 24-hour withdrawal-support program in Whitehorse for adults and youth, serving Whitehorse and Yukon communities.
records.population_served: People seeking the listed practical service
records.access_pathway: Call Withdrawal Management Services or the territorial intake worker to confirm current access before travelling.

records.name: Northwest Territories Community Counselling Program
records.description: Territorial community-counselling access with local or regional telephone contacts for adult, child, youth and family mental-health and addiction support.
records.population_served: People seeking the listed practical service

eligible_trip_types: Insured medical services unavailable in the home community

records.name: Nunavut Community Health Centre Access

records.description: Community health-centre access pathway for Nunavummiut seeking local health-provider support and connection to mental-health, addiction or travelling-care pathways.
